subject: display subset of a data frame

messages.author: 6172ba5a43c33a66
messages.subject: display subset of a data frame
parts:
Is that possible to display only a sub set of data frame. Like I have
a data frame as follow:
kind x y
1 1 39 40
2 1 1 25
3 1 23 9
4 2 10 4
5 2 72 33
6 3 44 22

I only want to display scatter plot of kind 1 (or 2,3), is that
possible? (I don't want to build another subset dataframe of this one,
in order to keep data in one variable.)
And what if I only want to display coordinates contained only in kind
1 rather than kind 2, is that possible?

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: display subset of a data frame
parts:
Hi:

Use the subset() function; e.g.,

ggplot(subset(mydata, kind == 1), aes(...)) + ...

You might also consider faceting (a.k.a. conditioning) by kind;
facet_grid() contains arguments to allow free scales in the x
direction, the y direction or both; free scales in one dimension is in
the development version 0.9.0 but not in 0.8.9. The help page of
facet_grid() in 0.9.0 contains a lot of useful examples.

Dennis
